Supply Agreement VC-2025-014
Contract no. VC-2025-014   Supplier no. 0000100101
This Supply Agreement is made on 2025-01-15 between Veltra Automotive GmbH ("Buyer") and
AluCast Iberia S.L., ES ("Supplier").
1. Scope
Supplier shall deliver Aluminium alloy A380 ingot to Buyer's plants in Wolfsried (DE) and Greenville
(US). Estimated annual volume: 1,300 metric tonnes. Volumes are non-binding forecasts; Buyer
commits to a minimum offtake of 909 t per contract year.
2. Term
The Agreement is effective from signature and expires on 2027-12-31. Either party may terminate
with 30 days written notice. ... [1451 more chars]

sections.heading: 1. Scope
sections.text: Supplier shall deliver Aluminium alloy A380 ingot to Buyer's plants in Wolfsried (DE) and Greenville (US). Estimated annual volume: 1,300 metric tonnes. Volumes are non-binding forecasts; Buyer commits to a minimum offtake of 909 t per contract year.

sections.heading: 2. Term
sections.text: The Agreement is effective from signature and expires on 2027-12-31. Either party may terminate with 30 days written notice. Renewal negotiations shall start no later than 15 days before expiry.

sections.heading: 3. Price
sections.text: The base price is 2.85 EUR/kg, delivered DAP Buyer's plant.

price_adjustment.fx_rule: The relative index change is calculated in the index currency; no currency conversion is applied to the adjustment.

levers.effect: Supplier must match a written offer from a qualified supplier that is more than 5% below the contract price, or Buyer may reallocate up to 30% of annual volume.
